items.description: Recovery of stolen bicycle incl. locksmith call-out and cutting seized lock
items.rationale: Recovery costs under 5.2.2(a),(b) are covered but fall in the mobility class, so the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit (4.2.2) is shared rateably with the repair lines. Recovery is likely the largest share of the claim, so about 55% of 500.

items.description: Repair of theft damage to frame and brakes
items.rationale: Theft damage is covered under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b), but the mobility sub-limit of EUR 500 including VAT applies in aggregate. The line is shared rateably with the recovery and labour lines, so about 35% of 500.

Labour and sundries serving the covered repair are part of repair cost under 7.1.7(d),(e), so they are indemnified within the shared EUR 500 sub-limit. They get a small rateable share, and the line could be treated as ancillary or duplicate.
